entries.17796f9e6f7033df: This business manufactures and sells ultra-precision machined parts such as ball bearings, and has been the company's core business since its founding. It also handles rod end bearings for aircraft, pivot assemblies for hard disk drives (HDDs) and screws for aircraft. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥281,151 million, up 10.0% from the previous year. The main reason for the increase was solid demand for ball bearings, the core product, from server demand for data centers and demand from aircraft.
entries.2953c7e1cd1d9d8d: This is a business not included in the reportable segments.
entries.3754cb8d6f8174aa: This business manufactures and sells automotive parts such as key sets, door latches and door handles, and components for industrial equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥332,249 million, up 1.3% from the previous year. The main reason for the increase was higher demand for communication antennas and industrial equipment components. Yushin Co., Ltd., Minebea Access Solutions Co., Ltd., Mitsumi Electric and others manufacture products.
entries.3bae82c920d6d357: A comprehensive precision components manufacturer that makes and sells precision components such as bearings, motors, semiconductors and automotive parts around the world.
entries.3ede194b1a3e9162: This business manufactures and sells semiconductor devices, optical devices, mechanical components and power supply components. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥590,263 million, up 16.1% from the previous year, the largest of the four reportable segments. The main reason for the revenue increase was higher sales of mechanical components. Mitsumi Electric, ABLIC, Minebea Connect, Honda Tsushin Kogyo, Minebea Power Device and others manufacture and sell products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from Nintendo Co., Ltd. was ¥207,978 million (12.5%) and revenue from the Apple Group was ¥188,510 million (11.3%); both are shown under the segment to which this business relates.
entries.48dcd9eb023e5055: Mechanical Parts such as Pivot Assemblies for HDDs
entries.d4b8c96baa4cce6a: Electronic Devices (electro devices such as LCD backlights, smart products, etc.)
entries.df7d5b458b23a0da: This business manufactures and sells small motors, electronic devices such as LCD backlights, and sensing devices such as measuring instruments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥456,517 million, up 6.9% from the previous year. The main reason for the increase was higher demand for fan motors. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from the Apple Group was ¥188,510 million (11.3%), and it is shown under the segment to which this business relates.
entries.eec08a7857db7f60: A business not included in reportable segments. It designs and develops software and manufactures in-house machinery. Minebea Software Solutions Co., Ltd. is in charge of this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,207 million, up 19.2% from the previous year.
